typography.instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H4 headings with tracking-tight. This font gives an authoritative, serious, yet warm and human feel appropriate for a formal report. Use Work Sans for all body text, labels, and UI elements. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: Follow the 'Organic & Earthy' archetype. Avoid harsh digital colors. The alignment status colors map to 🟢 (strong alignment), 🟡 (moderate), 🔵 (different perspective), 🟣 (need more info). These must be used strictly for data visualization in the Joint Alignment Snapshot and throughout the 10-page report.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Solid Backgrounds for the application shell. DO NOT use glassmorphism, as it feels too cold for a family wellness app. Use flat, warm solid backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.report_paper: The 10-page report viewer MUST feel like a physical document. The 'page' container should be pure white (#FFFFFF) with a soft diffuse shadow (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]) to contrast against the #FAF9F6 background.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E1D8 (subtle earthy border). Do not use thick or high-contrast dark borders unless for specific form accessibility.

layouts.landing_page: Use generous spacing (p-12 to p-24). Employ a Bento grid with asymmetrical image and text blocks. Keep it calm and focused on the child.
layouts.assessment_forms: Centralized, max-w-2xl forms with clear progress indicators. Use Shadcn components for forms.
layouts.report_viewer: Dashboard layout. Sidebar or top pagination to navigate the 10 pages. The main view contains a centered column max-w-4xl representing the 'Paper' (page). Ensure it is scrollable and responsive.
layouts.print_styles: CRITICAL: The report viewer must be print-friendly. Add CSS print media queries (@media print) to hide navigation, sidebars, and buttons, ensuring only the report content prints cleanly on A4/Letter size.

motion.transitions: Smooth fade-ins (opacity 0.2s ease) when navigating between report pages.
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-0.5 and shadow increase on cards and primary buttons.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, and Checkbox. Make inputs slightly taller (h-12) for accessibility and ease of use.
components.report_snapshot: For the 'Joint Alignment Snapshot' visual, use Shadcn Charts or Recharts to build a clean Donut chart or Stacked Bar showing the counts of aligned/different/need info areas. Label clearly: 'These numbers are not scores. They are a roadmap for conversation.'
components.action_plan: Page 9 (Parent Action Plan) should look like a printable worksheet with empty lined spaces or prominent text areas.
components.file_type_instruction: Ensure all React components are created as .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx files.

landing_hero_child.description: Child playing peacefully, to be used in the hero or 'Child at the Center' section of the landing page.

landing_zen_stones.description: Stacked zen stones representing alignment, balance, and structured co-parenting.

landing_parents.description: Parents standing together, representing a functional co-parenting system.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so write code for .js files not for .tsx files.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
Do NOT center align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Ensure the report page strictly follows the 10-page structure outlined in the problem statement.
Include a 'Demo/Simulator' mode with pre-filled sample data so the report viewer can be easily tested.
